title: Grothendieck weights and K-theoretic positivity for matroids
summary: We introduce a method for studying $K$-theoretic positivity on permutohedral toric varieties through the topology of spaces arising in tropical geometry. The key ingredient is the theory of Grothendieck weights developed by the author. We prove two positivity results using this method. The first result is the positivity of the Euler characteristics of tautological bundles associated with an arbitrary matroid and twisted by a nef line bundle.
